scope: Static helper and independent authored AST-slice probe only. The prior financial static/boundary PASS remains scoped and unchanged; no actual owner or journal accessed.

findings.issue: The collector loads five historical retained-journal-index.local.json files without binding their bytes/hash/size to already accepted index identities, then declares original_journals_unchanged after iterating their self-declared files. A replaced empty files map makes all journal checks vacuously pass. A changed source path or entries could also redirect the integrity-read scope.

reproduction.finding: Accepted index identity is not pinned before claiming original_journals_unchanged; replacing all five indexes with files:{} evades every journal hash comparison.

findings.impact: The exported original_journals_unchanged claim is not supported against changed index metadata; it can conceal deletion/mutation of all five old journal sets or drift in the indexed read scope. No evidence indicates such mutation actually happened.
findings.required_remedy: Before parsing or iterating each old index, bound and hash-check its exact bytes against the independently accepted historical index digest, and constrain source/entry paths or bind a known-safe exact source identity. Validate nonempty expected membership/counts. Preserve this reviewed unexecuted helper and finding; supply a separately pinned corrected helper plus authored empty/altered/redirected-index refusal controls. Do not edit past research evidence or run any model request to repair it.

probe_evidence.method: Extracted exact oldbase loop and original_journals_unchanged assignment from AST; ran only on five new empty authored indexes under reviewer tmp root, with sha256_file trap. No helper main or real owner/journal operations executed.
